t: For necessary expenses of the Office of the Secretary of the Interior, including teletype rentals and service; purchase of two passenger motor vehicles, of which one shall be for replacement only, and not to exceed $2,000 for official reception and representation expenses, $8,301,000.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation for the expenses of the Office of the Secretary of the Interior (teletype, vehicles, reception expenses). The tempting reading is that "reception and representation expenses" implies engagement with outsiders, but that is only a spending category. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given any role in a federal decision, and there is no rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue.
fable.s: not to exceed $2,000 for official reception and representation expenses
